fieldValues.title: The governance decision type lacks what a real group's decisions carry
fieldValues.summary: Loading a working group's eleven real decisions into governance/decision left no field for what each rules out, its declared interests, its links or its own number: they went into context and the title.
evidence: LTH Works decision format: question, options, decision, why, rules out, interests, links, revisit when, acted on
governance/decision 1.2.4 fields; muSrs and srs-programme both carry a stray status field
fieldValues.body: Governance 2.0 should take the group's format as a test case, add a subject link and a relation for tension between records.
